Inventory Value Summary

The Inventory Value Summary report shows the total cost value of your inventory holdings as of a specific date.

Each inventory item is valued using your chosen costing method (FIFO, average cost, or specific identification).

Use this report to verify inventory asset values for financial statements and insurance purposes.

Monitor inventory investment levels and identify slow-moving or high-value items requiring attention.

Configure the report date and filter by inventory location or item categories.

Description

Enter an optional description or title for this report to help identify it later.

From

Select the starting date for the inventory value analysis. Opening values will be calculated as of this date.

To

Select the ending date for the inventory value analysis. All value movements between the from and to dates will be included.

Exclude inventory items with no movement

Check this box to hide inventory items that had no value movement during the selected period. This helps focus on active inventory items only.
